user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's graduation, can you help me find out who they follow on Instagram and get their followers? Also, I want to check if they have any recent stories and view them.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the list of accounts that the best friend follows on Instagram.
Get the list of followers for the best friend's Instagram account.
Check for any recent stories posted by the best friend on Instagram.
View the recent stories of the best friend on Instagram.
